text: Patient reports cough and fatigue. Denies fever and chills.
She denies jaundice and edema. On exam, maculopapular rash noted.
67-year-old male presents with abdominal pain and vomiting. He denies diarrhea and constipation.
Endorses fatigue and weight loss. Negative for cough and fever.
Reports headache and nausea. No vomiting, no diarrhea.
Patient describes worsening muscle soreness since onset, but no observable limb weakness.
